verdict.rationale: Quo transcribes voicemails and its first-party MCP/AI connectors let a user pull missed calls and voicemail transcripts from a chat assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT, so they can be read without dialing in. That is on-demand retrieval, not automatic delivery: no evidence shows transcripts being pushed to email or a team chat app when a voicemail arrives. Missing for 10: automatic voicemail-to-email delivery, push notifications of transcripts into chat apps (e.g., Slack), independent or hands-on corroboration of transcript quality.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Get info about your missed calls to your Quo numbers, and see their voicemail transcripts directly from your chat.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server
